mcq_drop.why: criticism/debate statements, opinion-style; TN resolution trivia

pyq_bad.why: garbled: mixed with another question's statements/options
wrong topic: Union-State distribution of taxes (Art. 268)
suspect key: in 2009 GST was proposed from 1 April 2010; '10 April 2014' is not a real target date

patterns: APPSC asks GST Council basics: Article 279A (trap 269A), chair = Union FM, 3/4 weighted majority, constitutional not statutory.
Lists of what is outside GST (crude, ATF, natural gas, liquor, electricity) answered 'All the above' recur in APPSC.
Subsumed-tax questions (excise, service tax, VAT, CVD, octroi) and 'GST is an indirect / destination-based tax' are standard.
Bill vs Act number trap: 122nd Bill -> 101st Act.
App adds GST 2.0, compensation-cess and anti-profiteering current-affairs detail well beyond the PYQ depth.
